## What happened

Incident notice INC-0207 records an issue titled “Registry feed repeated reissued numbers”. The incident started on 2024-06-30. The notice concerns the registry feed and the repeated use of numbers that had been reissued. This record is provided to support review of the affected registry information and to ensure the incident is understood consistently.

## Cause

The recorded cause was: Ministry replayed a cached batch. The replay resulted in previously processed registry information being presented again in the feed. No further cause is recorded in this notice.

## Effect

The recorded effect was: Two people share one registry number in that month. This means that the registry number cannot be treated as uniquely identifying one person for the affected month without additional review. Questions about this notice should be directed to the service desk, quoting INC-0207.
